what: 01035 point 4: nothing in the daemon collects the codegen memo, so it only grows (crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/unit.rs:92, Shared::memo: Arc<Memo>). The API is there now: every blaze_codegen::driver::Built (and TieredUp) carries memo_used: Vec<ContentId>, sorted and each once, every memo entry the build took or put (template shapes, the release/folded/thunk store-key entries, summary landings, a lazy build's recorded shapes). Memo::retain(&mut self, kept: impl Fn(&ContentId) -> bool) drops every template and every single-flight landing (and landed summary) not kept. Asked: hold the memo so the daemon can have it alone between builds (for example Mutex<Arc<Memo>> in Shared, each build and each lazy run cloning the Arc at its start), keep the union of memo_used of the builds whose images or lazy runs the daemon still keeps, and when a job ends and Arc::get_mut succeeds (no build or run holds it) call memo.retain(|it| kept.binary_search(it).is_ok()) once the memo is past a bound of your choosing. A build in flight never sees a collection (retain takes &mut), and a dropped entry costs a recompile or a store read, never a wrong template: the store keeps every template by its stored key. Test it beside the daemon's: after a job whose image is dropped, its shapes are gone from the memo (Memo::len) and a rebuild still equals the first. Tests of the codegen side: driver/tests/flight.rs a_collection_keeps_what_a_build_used_and_drops_the_rest.
